handler.sourceBytePins: Opcode 0x0C dispatch at GAME.OVR 0x424e calls handler 0x0d35; handler prefetches three operands and stores operand positions 0/1/2 to DS:0x72e9, area2+0x580, and DS:0x72ea respectively. It computes and clamps a separate extent at area2+0x582, then passes DS:0x72e9, DS:0x72ea, that extent, and DS:0x8830 to descriptor procedure 0x4e:0x48 (mapped to GAME.OVR 0x8fb6 in cok-composed-startup-capture-2026-09-27.md).
handler.graphicsLinkStatus: The opcode handler span alone records state stores; retailGraphicsLink separately pins the downstream conditional SPRIT/PIC selector path.

bankSuffixLifecycle.interpretation: New-game paths initialize bank 1; a current-area record restores the value and receives it back when stored. This does not establish the value at every ECL site or justify deriving it from ECL1/2/3.DAX.

These are source-byte and static call-path findings, not runtime observation or runtime-art admission.
